hook.say: True or false? Five facts about Turkey, three seconds each. Number five surprises people every Christmas!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.fact: Ankara is the capital. Istanbul is by far the largest city.
questions.sayAnswer: False! Ankara is the capital, but Istanbul is by far the largest city.

questions.q: The ancient city of Troy is in Türkiye.
questions.say: The ancient city of Troy is in Turkey.
questions.fact: The ruins of Troy lie in Çanakkale province, in the northwest.
questions.sayAnswer: True! The ruins of Troy lie in northwestern Turkey, not in Greece.

questions.q: Most of Türkiye's land is in Europe.
questions.say: Most of Turkey's land is in Europe.
questions.fact: About 97% of Türkiye lies in Asia. Only about 3% is in Europe.
questions.sayAnswer: False! About 97 percent of Turkey lies in Asia.

questions.fact: Greece, Bulgaria, Georgia, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Iran, Iraq and Syria.
questions.sayAnswer: True! From Greece and Bulgaria all the way round to Iraq and Syria. 8 neighbors.

questions.q: The real Saint Nicholas, the origin of Santa Claus, lived in Türkiye.
questions.say: The real Saint Nicholas, the origin of Santa Claus, lived in Turkey.
questions.fact: He was bishop of Myra, today's Demre on the Mediterranean coast.
questions.sayAnswer: True! He was bishop of Myra, now the town of Demre on Turkey's south coast.
